result.tender_summary: This tender is issued by the University Works Department, University of Hyderabad, for providing electrical wiring points for computers at AI Labs within the campus. The estimated cost of the work is Rs. 2,38,400 with a completion period of two weeks.
result.overall_assessment: This tender is for a small-scale electrical works contract (estimated at approx. Rs 2.38 lakhs) with standard eligibility criteria (Class B electrical license, standard past completion thresholds scaled to the contract value, and recognized CPWD/DSR norms). The inclusion of broad lists of standard multi-brand options for materials prevents vendor lock-in. Overall, this is a clean, routine public works tender with no identifiable pattern of restrictive or unfair conditions.
